_comment: Primus pretrain across MULTIPLE pods (Indexed Job). Each pod uses k8s.gpu_count GPUs; nnodes matches pod count. Same file as single-node for any Primus backend: set primus.config_path; BACKEND inferred from model name (primus_pretrain/<launcher>_...) unless primus.backend is set. Usage: madengine build/run ... --additional-context-file examples/k8s-configs/basic/primus-multi-node.json
